purpose: Separate diagnostic for transfer-horizon forecasts; do not infer multi-transfer policy gains from one-week RMSE.
labels: sum next six actual numbered gameweeks, including start; all features frozen at start cutoff
admission: Every future GW must have an observed player target, or a verified blank for the origin club. Unknown registration/coverage is excluded and counted, never turned into zero. This conditional-coverage population is not the entire deadline roster.
schedule: fixture counts use realised retrospective schedules; no claim of archived schedule foresight
purge: training labels end within a completed earlier season and finish before first outer deadline
models: rolling-rate baseline, 2 ridge penalties, 4 LightGBM size/recency combinations, 2 CatBoost depths
selection: same earlier three available OOF seasons, equal season MSE; no outer test selection
tests: 2018/19 through 2025/26; current only two heavily overlapping six-week windows, no precise current inference
DC: remove summed actual DC awards from training labels only, add lag-only expected DC for known future fixture count
